title: Mobile Navigation
description: Vertical stacked nav for the dedicated mobile-menu template part. Full-width rows with a hairline divider between items, contrast-coloured links turning brand-500 on press. The borderless hamburger trigger and its 28px icon live in assets/styles/core-navigation.css — the css field cannot express them because they target core's generated .wp-block-navigation__responsive-container-open wrapper at a specificity the :where()-wrapped css field cannot reach.
